title: Server Port Inquiry
description: Help the operations team identify the port number that the server is listening on by making tool calls.

planning.prompt: Before touching the workspace, write one short sentence about what you need to do. Your thinking note will be added to the context window.

system: You are a helpful assistant. Answer the user's question.

briefing.message: What port does the server listen on? I am trying to configure the firewall and need to know the port number.

answerResponses.correct: Great, that was the right port!
answerResponses.incorrect: No, that didn't seem to be the right port.

hints: Pause before requesting more help: what have you already inspected, and what evidence is still missing?
Use the file list to narrow your search, then inspect the configuration file most likely to contain the server port.
